description: Use this when the user asks what they are not monitoring, what could break without them knowing, whether their monitoring is complete, or what to set up next. Returns the gaps in what the user can see, worst first, each with the tool that fixes it and, where the user may turn that suggestion off, the dismiss_suggestion key: services FlareWarden found a site relying on that no dependency watches, certificates expiring within 30 days (tracked subdomains included), sites on no status page, sites whose alerts reach one person or nobody, and monitors paused for weeks. Changes nothing in the account. A site whose services FlareWarden has not looked at in the last week has its DNS records and home page read in the background, and a later call includes what that finds. Not for what is down now: use get_account_overview.
